manualReview.scope: Model/editor Quality v3 remediation review of EN-A1-L-0129; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: Target-bearing learner lines ‘This is my hand.’ and ‘This is my other hand.’ are grammatical and natural in the controlled activity context.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Persian copy consistently maps hand to «دست» and preserves the body-part sense.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: Dialogue-dependent tasks are ordered after exposure, duplicate exact-sentence assessment is practice-only, and hidden-answer retrieval remains the strongest evidence.

distractorQuality.evidence: Distractors preserve simple syntax while changing the noun meaning.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Generic story metadata was replaced where needed by scene copy grounded in the canonical setting and turns.

difficultyFit.evidence: Production is short and concrete, with one body-part noun and familiar demonstrative/possessive frames.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: Repeated exact target sentences may remain for practice, but only the strongest occurrence is scored; this reduces false mastery from repeated identical answers.

transferQuality.evidence: The second response shifts from one hand to the other while preserving the same body-part sense.

overallCoherence.evidence: All scored content remains bounded to the body-part meaning of hand.

learnerExperience.evidence: Runtime ordering and answer tolerance were improved, but no real learner test is claimed.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
Only the bounded body-part sense of hand is reviewed.
Generated audio pronunciation/prosody is not evaluated at this text stage.
Quality v3 remediation was model/editor reviewed; real learner evidence is still required before public-release readiness.
resolvedFindings: English turns and options were checked for grammar and internal consistency.
Persian orthography and English–Persian meaning consistency were checked.
Reference key, part of speech, sense key, and provisional spec hash were cross-checked against the worker packet.

Community story arc returns after 5 Lessons with a changed learner role.

The Lesson 0129 target-collocation audit was repaired by adding explicit exact fallbacks for ‘me your hand’, ‘is my hand’, ‘the other hand’, and ‘my other hand’; each is tied to existing turn text and no learner-facing wording changed.
Quality v3: dialogue exposure, duplicate scoring, safe speech equivalence and grounded story copy rechecked after deterministic remediation.
